definitions.gloss: to start sliding; to begin to slip
definitions.explanation: To begin sliding or slipping on a surface. Used for physical sliding motion.

definitions.gloss: to get off to a start; to launch; to get underway
definitions.explanation: Figuratively, to begin a new venture, season, or period. Often used with adjectives like 好調 (strong) or 順調 (smooth) to describe how something has started.

examples.japanese: ⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{坂道|さかみち}→坂道：08166_sakamichi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{滑|すべ}り{出|だ}した。
examples.english: The car started sliding on the slope.
My feet started sliding on the ice and I fell.

examples.japanese: ⟦{雪|ゆき}→雪：00584_yuki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ゆっくり→ゆっくり：00910_yukkuri⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{屋根|やね}→屋根：02264_yane⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{滑|すべ}り{出|だ}した。
examples.english: The snow slowly began to slide off the roof.

examples.japanese: {新|しん}⟦シーズン→シーズン：10944_shiizun⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{好調|こうちょう}→好調：12209_kouchou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{滑|すべ}り{出|だ}した。
examples.english: The new season got off to a strong start.

examples.english: Sales of the new product got off to a smooth start.

examples.english: I had some anxiety about my new life, but it got underway more smoothly than I expected.

notes:
USAGE:
Sense 2 is especially common in sports and business contexts. The noun form ⟦{滑|すべ}り{出|だ}し→滑り出し：28049_suberidashi⟧ means "the start" or "the beginning" and is frequently used: ⟦{滑|すべ}り{出|だ}し→滑り出し：28049_suberidashi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{好調|こうちょう}→好調：12209_kouchou⟧だ (the start is going well).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{好調|こうちょう}→好調：12209_kouchou⟧な⟦{滑|すべ}り{出|だ}し→滑り出し：28049_suberidashi⟧ (a strong start)
- ⟦{順調|じゅんちょう}→順調：03282_junchou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{滑|すべ}り{出|だ}す (to get off to a smooth start)
- ⟦{滑|すべ}り{出|だ}し→滑り出し：28049_suberidashi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{良|い}い (to have a good start)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦スタート→スタート：11053_sutaato⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{切|き}る→切る：02693_kiru⟧: to make a start — more general
- ⟦{走|はし}り{出|だ}す→走り出す：06679_hashiridasu⟧: to start running — physical movement only
- {出足|であし}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{良|い}い: to have a good start — often for sales or attendance
